turns.content:
The grammar defines `true` as matching `"ture"`:

```lark
?atom: NUMBER          -> num
     | "ture"          -> true
     | "false"         -> false
     | "(" expr ")"
```

If the input is `'true + 1'`, the parser sees `true`. Since the grammar only has `"ture"`, it will match the substring `"ture"` and then be left with `"tr"` which is not part of a valid token, leading to an error.

The fix is to change `"ture"` to `"true"` in `calc/grammar.lark`.
